reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model SE4570, which is a recalled model.
The label date code reads 07/22 NH, which is one of the recalled date codes.
The purchase was from Grainger, a listed retailer, on 2022-10-14, inside the sale window of 2022-09-01 to 2023-09-30. No receipt is required for this claim.
No other claim shares a photo, address, email, serial, or payout account with this claim.
The remedy is repair or replacement, not a refund, so the value threshold does not apply and no destruction photo is required.
